params.name: keys
params.description: Key name for which you need to get the value.

params.name: fetch_all
params.description: If true, returns all mobile setting keys (used by clients).

items.docs:
Returns the current mobile settings for the authenticated user. The response includes notification preferences, media settings, AV behavior, and summary-related options.

OAuth Scope: ZohoCliq.Profile.READ
Duration: 5
Threshold: 20 requests per min per user
Lock period: 5 minutes

params.name: file_summary
params.description: Quickly toggle file summary without a request body.

items.docs:
Updates mobile settings for the authenticated user. Send only the fields you want to modify. For nested objects (for example, `notification` or `media_to_gallery`), send the object with the intended values. You can also update `file_summary` directly using the query parameter.

OAuth Scope: ZohoCliq.Profile.UPDATE
Duration: 5
Threshold: 20 requests per min per user
Lock period: 5 minutes
